summary: Iteration 8 verified all 6 new features end-to-end on the live preview. FRONTEND E2E (Playwright, real backend + real Telegraph): (1) Login admin@mediabot.local/admin123 OK. (2) HASHTAGS: /new -> filled title + description, typed 'лето'+Enter and 'осень'+',' into [data-testid=hashtags-field] -> chips '#лето' '#осень' rendered inside [data-testid=hashtags-input] with per-chip [data-testid=hashtag-<name>]; uploaded cover PNG; editor-save -> dashboard -> job completed -> post row appears with correct title. (3) TWO LINKS: Created a photo+video post via API (POST /posts/draft with media=[photo,video], slots=[1,2]), uploaded 1x1 PNG to slot 1 and a real 2.8MB MP4 to slot 2 -> backend produced photos_url=telegra.ph/…-2 AND videos_url=telegra.ph/…-3 with photo_count=1, video_count=1. Dashboard row rendered BOTH [data-testid=photos-link-<id>] (📷 фото) and [data-testid=videos-link-<id>] (🎬 видео) with their copy buttons [data-testid=copy-photos-<id>] / [data-testid=copy-videos-<id>]. For photos-only post only photos-link appeared (no videos-link). (4) MEDIA COUNTS: [data-testid=photo-count-<id>] shows 1, [data-testid=video-count-<id>] shows 0 (photos-only) and 1/1 for mixed. (5) SEARCH: typing 'TEST_ hashtags' into [data-testid=posts-search] with 400ms debounce filtered to 1 row; 'ZZZ_nomatch_xyz123' shows 'Ничего не найдено'; clearing restores all rows and resets to page 1. (6) DELETE DIALOG: clicking [data-testid=delete-<id>] opens [data-testid=delete-dialog] with [data-testid=del-channel-checkbox] rendered with disabled attribute (empty string = HTML disabled) because post has no channel_message_id, plus helper text '(этот пост не публиковался — нечего удалять)'; [data-testid=del-media-checkbox] is data-state='checked' by default; [data-testid=del-cancel] closes dialog without deleting; [data-testid=del-confirm] fires DELETE /api/posts/<id>?delete_channel=false&delete_media=true and the row disappears. (7) EDIT + HASHTAGS: navigating to /edit/<id> loaded [data-testid=edit-description] with 'Описание статьи' (NO hashtag line leaked in) and the '#лето'/'#осень' chips loaded back into [data-testid=hashtags-input]; edit-save persisted. (8) PAGINATION selectors [data-testid=pagination/pagination-prev/pagination-next] confirmed in Dashboard.jsx (only render when totalPages>1; not triggered here — 1 post total). All flows pass. Backend already at 69/69 pytest per iter7; no new backend tests needed for this frontend-focused round. Cleaned up: 0 TEST_/SMOKE_ posts remain.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx L116: search q is interpolated into URL via encodeURIComponent which is correct, but the whole load() also fires on every debounce tick — consider AbortController to cancel prior in-flight /posts requests when user types quickly, otherwise late responses can overwrite newer ones (race).

Dashboard.jsx delete dialog: del-channel-checkbox uses shadcn Checkbox with `disabled={!channel_message_id}`; when disabled, Radix does NOT render aria-disabled — only the HTML disabled attribute is set on the underlying button. Tests should check `disabled` attribute (empty string), not aria-disabled. Not a bug but worth noting for future test scripts.

HashtagsInput.jsx clean(): regex strips [^\wа-яёА-ЯЁ] AFTER trimming leading #, but does NOT support other Cyrillic/Latin alphabets (Kazakh ә, ғ, Ukrainian і, ї, etc.) — for a Russian-only UI it's fine but a Unicode-property escape like \p{L}\p{N} would be more inclusive.

Dashboard.jsx L138-142 polling: interval fires load() every 2.5s while any job is in the jobs list, but jobs are never auto-removed after `done` — check UploadContext to ensure jobs are cleared post-completion (otherwise polling never stops until page refresh).

Dashboard.jsx L170 URL: passes booleans as query strings 'true'/'false'. Backend delete_post signature uses `delete_channel: bool = False` which FastAPI parses correctly, but if the frontend ever sent 'True' (capitalized) it would fail. Current usage is safe.

Server.py create_draft L389-397: slots list is built by appending len(blocks) BEFORE the block is appended; that's actually correct (idx=len before append equals current insertion index). Confirmed behaviour: draft returned slots=[1,2] when description block occupies index 0.

Video 5GB cap: not exercised in preview (no >2GB file available). Backend limit change is code-visible in server.py upload_media_slot; recommend explicit unit test with mocked file.size to prove the guard fires at 5GB and not earlier.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new features working end-to-end. Key data-testids introduced this round: hashtags-input, hashtags-field, hashtag-<name>, photos-link-<id>, videos-link-<id>, copy-photos-<id>, copy-videos-<id>, photo-count-<id>, video-count-<id>, posts-search, delete-dialog, del-channel-checkbox, del-media-checkbox, del-cancel, del-confirm. Backend POST /posts/draft body uses `media: [{kind, is_cover, caption}]` (NOT `slots:`) and returns {id, slots:[<block indices>]}. Upload endpoint is POST /posts/{id}/media/{idx} with idx being the block index (description text occupies idx 0 when present, so first media slot is idx=1). Delete endpoint accepts query params delete_channel & delete_media (both bools, defaults false/true). Video pagination (max_items=10) was not exercised end-to-end in the UI (would require 11+ real MP4 uploads); backend logic exists in _finalize_post + create_paginated_page and iter 7 backend tests cover the create_paginated_page helper. Frontend fetches /posts with `?q=` for search — verify AbortController if you touch search in the future to avoid race conditions.
